title: Bloodthirsty│嗜血
description: Vindicator heals itself after dealing damage.│衛道士在造成傷害以後會治癒自身。
body:
# Function│功能
Whenever Vindicator attacks and the damage is not blocked, it heals itself for 4 health.│每當衛道士進行攻擊並且該傷害未被格擋，會恢復自身4生命。
